title: Визит Вики в больницу  (Vika's Visit to the Hospital)

segments.t: Back at Claude Monet, Chef Barinov is stunned when Malafeev walks into the dining room healthy and cheerful, having never touched the poisoned dish. Meanwhile at the hospital, Max steps into the corridor while Sasha hides under his blanket, only to run straight into Vika arriving to visit him.
Шеф, ну, надеюсь, вы не собираете его?
Я до матча этого не сделал.
Лавров, я бы вам советовала прилечь.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
'That football player from yesterday just arrived.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'there' and finishing on 'came'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Do not be afraid.' Spoken Russian keeps this brief and expressive, built right around 'be afraid' without extra helper words.
'Thank you for warning me.' Vika anchors the line on 'thank you', while 'warned' completes the thought.
Шеф, ну, надеюсь, вы не собираете его?
'Chef, I hope you are not planning to poison him again?' Notice how Russian expresses 'chef' and 'him' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Lyova, I beg of you.' The grammar packs 'Lev' and 'I beg' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Я до матча этого не сделал.
'I did not even succeed before the match.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'to do' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Why would I do it now?' Notice how Russian expresses 'what for' and 'any minute' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Now that is the right attitude, Viktor Petrovich.' Notice how Russian expresses 'there you go' and 'Petrovich' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Oh, there he is.' Vika anchors the line on 'and', while 'he' completes the thought.
'How are you feeling?' Max brings out the contrast between 'how' and 'you' in a few short words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
Лавров, я бы вам советовала прилечь.
'Lavrov, I would advise you to lie back down.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'Lavrov', while 'will lie down briefly' completes the thought.
'All right, yes, let us get you into bed.' The grammar packs 'really?!' and 'will lie down' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Where is your hospital room?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'and' and finishing on 'hospital room'. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.

That wraps up this scene as malafeev returns to the restaurant completely unharmed, and at the hospital Vika arrives to visit Max while Sasha is waiting inside his ward. See you next time!
